rollout.notes: First-order single-backtrace semi-Lagrangian advection, as used in training and in the trainer's evaluation. The evaluation rollout clamps and renormalises total mass every step; the training rollout with --peak-norm skipped the renormalisation.

data.notes: Source: 8 identical copies of a sigmoid soft ball (softness 0.2) whose total mass matches the targets (~7967). Targets: watertight airplane meshes voxelized at 128^3 and filled, Gaussian blur sigma 0.7 voxel, resized to total mass 8000 (init-fill 0.7, margin 0.9). --raw-sampler --peak-norm: clamp only, peak density 1. ShapeNet terms apply; the voxel data is not shipped.

training.init: from scratch (--init-scale 10.0 on the last projection layer)
training.args_note: Flags of the original launch command (original entry point: fluidot_improved.train_3d). `--save-dir` is omitted; absolute data paths of the original run are rewritten relative to the repository root (data/...). `advection` is new in the release package and made explicit here; the original code hard-wired this scheme.
training.command: python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 -m viot.train_3d --resolution 128 --sampler shapenet --data-path-src data/sphere_match_airplanes_s02_128.pt --data-path-tgt data/shapenet_airplanes_wtt_volresize_n8000_128.pt --batch-size 6 --lr 1e-4 --n-steps 5000 --n-rollout 10 --n-test 10 --n-infer-steps 50 --k-max 0.25 --fno-width 32 --fno-modes 16 --fno-layers 6 --bb-visc-only --lambda-ke 0.0 --lambda-mu 0.003 --lambda-mu-warmup 1000 --lambda-terminal 10.0 --amp --checkpoint --log-every 100 --no-scheduler --grad-clip 1.0 --raw-sampler --peak-norm --init-scale 10.0 --advection semi_lagrangian
training.original_args_note: Relative to the original launch command: --data-path-src .data/sphere_match_airplanes_s02_128.pt -> data/sphere_match_airplanes_s02_128.pt; --data-path-tgt .data/shapenet_airplanes_wtt_volresize_n8000_128.pt -> data/shapenet_airplanes_wtt_volresize_n8000_128.pt. Data files are expected under data/ (see scripts/data/README.md).

checkpoint.selection: model_best: lowest single-training-batch terminal loss among the checkpoints saved every 1000 steps (not a validation criterion)
checkpoint.state_dict_note: keys and tensors identical to the original .pt state_dict, including the trunc_mask buffer

end_of_training_eval_final_weights.note: terminal L2 printed by the trainer's end-of-training evaluation (seed 42) on the final weights of this run, not on this checkpoint; useful as a reference when retraining
